attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his signed Substack post. The neighbouring Turkewitz quote is separate and is not part of this claim.

semantics.note: The normalised claim keeps the 'so far as I know' qualifier and the scope: the people claiming the singularity (Altman, Musk, Huang). It is an observation about Marcus's own knowledge, which makes it untestable in practice.

contract.note: The contract keeps the knowledge qualifier and does not turn the line into a universal negative about the whole public record. The not_applicable axis is reasonable, because only Marcus's state of knowledge could settle it.

reviews.rationale: The claim reports what Marcus knew when he published. No outside evidence can establish or refute his state of knowledge, and his own assertion cannot prove itself. The packet has no outcome evidence and lists no counterevidence. The claim is untestable as stated, so it is not adjudicable.
